title: account_tax_group / tax repartition — Thai WHT/VAT computation mechanics (GAP-046 sub-scope)

key_findings.finding: compute_all at account_tax.py:4975 is the canonical public API returning all amounts and account references needed for PND form population
key_findings.gap_relevance: GAP-046 PND generation must call or replicate compute_all output

key_findings.finding: Thai WHT is standard Odoo percent tax with type_tax_use=none, tax_exigibility=on_payment, and a current-liability account on the repartition tax line
key_findings.gap_relevance: No custom WHT computation engine is required; standard config suffices

key_findings.finding: Cash basis (on_payment) WHT uses cash_basis_transition_account_id as intermediate; final WHT Payable posting occurs at payment reconciliation via CABA
key_findings.gap_relevance: PND form population must read amounts from payment/CABA entries, not invoice entries

key_findings.finding: use_in_tax_closing on repartition lines auto-computed: true for tax-type lines with non-income/expense accounts; controls tax period close participation
key_findings.gap_relevance: WHT repartition lines with liability accounts will participate in tax closing by default

key_findings.finding: Thai VAT 7% price-included: extraction formula is base = gross / 1.07, tax = gross - base = gross * 0.07/1.07
key_findings.gap_relevance: PND forms typically report WHT base as the net amount before VAT; computation confirmed at line 1097-1115

gap_046_assessment.detail: Core tax computation mechanics are fully present in standard Odoo Community. The compute_all API provides all data (base, tax amounts, account_ids, repartition_line_ids, tax_exigibility) needed for PND form generation. GAP-046 requires a custom module to extract these values from posted journal entries and format them into Thai Revenue Department PND 1, PND 3, and PND 53 forms. The computation foundation exists; the reporting extraction layer does not.

accounting_posting_pattern_wht.description: Thai vendor invoice with 3% WHT (price-excluded) and 7% VAT (price-included)
at_invoice: DR Expense account (gross amount incl. VAT, the price entered)
CR Accounts Payable (net = gross - WHT amount)
DR Input VAT transition account OR Input VAT account
CR WHT Payable current liability account (3% of base before VAT)
at_payment_caba: CABA reconciliation moves tax from transition to final account
